scope.market_definition: The Virtual Health Service Market encompasses digital platforms and services that facilitate remote healthcare delivery, including telemedicine, remote patient monitoring, and digital health applications. Participants include technology providers, healthcare institutions, and various channel partners that distribute and integrate these services globally.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of virtual health services through various channel partners.
This layer focuses on the integration of virtual health services into existing healthcare systems.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## More than telehealth

Amwell provides payers and healthcare systems with a single technology-based care platform. Working
with our clients, we help people get easier access to care across the continuum. This includes many
healthcare programs from Amwell and our growing list of partners.  

## Redefining mental healthcare at scale

A landmark, NIMH-funded study across 26 U.S. colleges shows how proactive, population-based, digital
behavioral health can identify need earlier and measurably reduce mental disorders over time.
* Early screening + digital intervention **lowered disorder prevalence by up to 4.9%**, with
  sustained impact over 2 years. 
* Participation more than doubled—**74.4% vs. 30.2%**—proving accessible, guided tools get people
  into care.
* A **3.8% reduction** at scale translated to up to **$1.18M in avoided costs**, showing real
  clinical and financial value.

## More than telehealth

Amwell provides payers and healthcare systems with a single technology-based care platform. Working
with our clients, we help people get easier access to care across the continuum. This includes many
healthcare programs from Amwell and our growing list of partners.  

## Redefining mental healthcare at scale

A landmark, NIMH-funded study across 26 U.S. colleges shows how proactive, population-based, digital
behavioral health can identify need earlier and measurably reduce mental disorders over time.
* Early screening + digital intervention **lowered disorder prevalence by up to 4.9%**, with
  sustained impact over 2 years. 
* Participation more than doubled—**74.4% vs. 30.2%**—proving accessible, guided tools get people
  into care.
* A **3.8% reduction** at scale translated to up to **$1.18M in avoided costs**, showing real
  clinical and financial value.

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

With 20+ years of vast experience in the field of [telemedicine][23], Apollo Hospitals has created
the largest and oldest multi-specialty telemedicine network in South Asia. Being one of the global
pioneers of telemedicine, Apollo serves both the urban and rural communities by enhancing the
accessibility of quality healthcare.

Apollo TeleHealth specialises in integrated healthcare delivery to provide services such as
[TeleConsultations][24], [Tele Radiology][25], [Tele Cardiology][26], Tele Condition Management, and
Tele-ICU services among others.

to Apollo’s specialists for interpretation and/or consultation.

The transforming healthcare scenario in India has led to the advent of HomeCare – Health care
services at home for the convenience of patients and their families.

# Extend Your Care Team with a Virtual Health System

Reduce staffing gaps, improve patient outcomes, and expand access to specialty care.

[View Our Services][25]

#### Virtual Care, Perfected.

Avel eCare was one of the first Virtual Health System in the nation to start offering
clinician-to-clinician services via a virtual health system platform. Since 1993, Avel’s
multi-disciplinary teams have delivered exceptional virtual care impacting millions of patients in
communities across the United States.

[Joint commission seal/badge]

The Joint Commission’s standards are based on expert input and scientific evidence to help
healthcare organizations measure, assess, and improve performance.

## Virtual Health System with Proven Excellence

### 3M+

Patients Treated Every Year



#### How it works

[][26]

### The National Healthcare Challenges Avel is Solving

Avel eCare is fundamentally changing the way healthcare is delivered in this country by solving
industry-wide problems.

##### 1) Solve Clinical Staffing Shortage

Managing clinical staffing is crucial, from recruitment, to retention, and limiting burnout. Avel’s
board-certified physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, social workers, and
more embed with your staff and allow for efficient staffing models and ensure excellent patient
care.

##### 2) Expand Access to Care

Working with Avel eCare allows for expanded access to a suite of physicians and clinicians
representing 15 distinct specialties. Hospitals and clinics can treat more patients locally by
partnering with Avel.

##### 3) Improve Patient Outcomes

Avel eCare is a TJC accredited virtual hospital. Our customers have access to physicians, nurses,
and clinicians that are virtual health system experts. Avel’s customers count on improved patient
outcomes due to the added support and expertise.

##### 4) Improve Financial Outcomes

Avel’s unique business model allows hospitals and health systems to employ more flexible staffing
models, limit transfer rates, and treat more patients locally. Avel has a proven track record of
reducing unnecessary costs and driving more revenue for our customers.

## Our Services

Avel delivers the broadest array of solutions and care delivery models to meet the needs of a wide
range of hospitals, care centers, health systems and other ambulatory care providers.

[Learn More][27]
[Mind Map Final drop shadow]

## Pharmacy

Facilities and hospitals count on Avel eCare Pharmacy to meet their pharmaceutical needs 24/7/365.
Avel pharmacists partner with local pharmacies and/or professional staff to ensure patients receive
the safest and most effective medication management..



## Hospitalist

Avel eCare Hospitalist virtual health system services deliver high-quality care and management of
complex, medical and surgical patients who are 18 years of age and older.



## Senior Care

Avel eCare Senior Care works with facilities to be a 24/7 extension of their local care team,
providing round-the-clock service to senior care residents to augment care and improve outcomes.



## School Health

Avel eCare School Health provides nurse coverage for the entire school day and ensures immediate
response to student needs. School systems can count on school nurse experts to manage student health
while reducing the burden on staff.



## Behavioral Health

Avel eCare Behavioral Health provides emergency departments, inpatient behavioral health, and acute
inpatient units with expert evaluations from mental health professionals.



## Critical Care/ICU

Avel eCare ICU provides critically ill patients with 24/7 monitoring and support. This innovative
model connects hospitals to board-certified intensivists for constant monitoring, faster
interventions, and lower risks from complications.



## EMS

Partner with Avel eCare EMS to expedite care and provide the best pre-hospital care possible to your
community. Ave is here to support EMS personnel by lending a virtual hand when they need it.



## Crisis Care

Avel eCare Crisis Care is a virtual co-responder solution that supports Law Enforcement with 24/7
access to behavioral health experts who can de-escalate situations and help treat individuals in
crisis.



## Specialty Clinic

Avel eCare Specialty Clinic provides access to medical specialty care through high-definition,
interactive video technology. More than 15 distinct specialties are available for on-demand or
scheduled consults.



## Emergency

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# The Right
# Care, When it Matters

Lyric is a virtual-first healthcare platform built to streamline access, reduce friction, and drive
meaningful claims cost reduction by guiding members to the right care, when and how they need it. By
combining an integrated suite of virtual care services with 24/7 care navigation, Lyric delivers a
seamless, connected healthcare experience from first touch to resolution.

[ Request a Demo ][23]

A Virtual-First Care Platform Built for Modern Healthcare Access

Lyric delivers a comprehensive virtual-first care experience that replaces fragmented point
solutions with a single, connected platform. From primary and urgent care to behavioral health,
men’s and women’s health, musculoskeletal care, and chronic condition management, Lyric expands
access to high-quality care while supporting smarter utilization.

## A virtual-first approach to member navigation

Connecting a fragmented healthcare system

At Lyric, our integrated approach to virtual care treats the complete you. From triage and specialty
referral to treatment and beyond. Our simple-to-use virtual care suite integrates labs, pharmacy,
and RPM tools to support both acute and chronic care. It’s thoughtful, more inclusive care that
enhances value and improves healthcare outcomes.

## Integrated Care from an
## award-winning team

Our nationwide network of licensed physicians, pediatricians, dermatologists, psychiatrists, and
therapists delivers personalized care for a wide range of medical and mental health needs.

With an average of over 10 years of professional experience, our providers are highly skilled and
knowledgeable.

Our clinical team is dedicated to providing compassionate, friendly, and expert care, connecting
with patients through phone or video for a seamless and supportive healthcare experience.

[ Learn More ][24]

## Get virtual first care when you need it most!

Urgent Care

24/7 on-demand access to licensed physicians to help with non-emergency needs

Primary Care

Get ongoing, personalized care from a provider committed to your complete health

Mental Health

Visit with a caring mental health professional for depression, anxiety, or other concerns

Dermatology

Get a treatment plan for acne, eczema, or other conditions

#### Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)

GTS has created a convenient and cost-effective remote patient monitoring SaaS platform that allows
healthcare providers to monitor streamed vital data from remotely located patients as well video
conference using HIPAA compliant video.

#### Real-time Telehealth

GTS’s remote telemonitoring program allows us to manage a patient’s condition daily from any
location - within or outside the US. The program utilizes state-of-the-art technology, advanced
telemetric equipment and custom-designed assessments to provide effective, remote patient care.

#### [ Global Monitoring System][10]

GTS offers an assortment of telehealth tools that enable healthcare providers to design a global
monitoring platform that best fits their organization's needs. For ease of use, convenience and
efficiency, the monitoring platform and data collected can be accessed through a tablet, smartphone,
computer or application.

[GTS VirtualHealth - Telehealth Software]

#### Store and Forward Technology

Includes digital images, video, audio and clinical data that can be "stored" on the client's
computer and when appropriate, information can be transmitted securely through our HIPAA compliant
servers ("forwarded") to the healthcare provider for improved patient care and coordination.

#### Next-level features

GTS telehealth tools can be used for a variety of applications such as transmitting medical images
and data for diagnosis; education, prevention and promotion of healthy behavior, and notification of
emergent cases. Telehealth monitors the patient between physician office visits and is very
beneficial to patients whose healthcare options are limited due to distance.

At our urgent care facility, your health is of utmost importance to us. We recognize the
significance of your well-being and strive to provide the highest level of care possible. From the
moment you walk through our doors, we are dedicated to ensuring that you feel heard, understood, and
supported. Our compassionate healthcare professionals take the time to listen to your concerns,
thoroughly assess your condition, and develop a personalized treatment plan tailored to your
specific needs. We firmly believe that every individual deserves access to quality healthcare, and
we are committed to delivering it with the utmost professionalism, respect, and empathy. Your health
and well-being are at the core of everything we do, and we are here to support you on your journey
to a healthier and happier life.

# Welcome to OnPatient

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

## Got a question?

Can the Simple app help me lose weight?
The Simple app can help you lose weight — and it can help you with much more than that, too. You'll
learn how to make healthy, balanced eating choices. You'll feel more confident and in control with
food. You'll get fitter, drink more water, and have more energy. You'll develop the skills to
prioritize self-care and live a healthier lifestyle. (We're excited for you, honestly!)
Does Simple make me count calories, cut out carbs, or weigh all my food?
Nope. The Simple method doesn't include calorie counting, cutting out essential food groups, or
weighing every bite. Instead, we prioritize safety and sustainability. So, we'll coach you to lose
weight through a behavior change approach that teaches you how to meet your nutritional needs, get
active, safely intermittent fast, and more.
How will Simple’s coaching be customized to me?
The coaching experience you’ll get with Simple is built around you. From the moment you create your
Simple account, you’re the star of the show. Here’s how: Your personal AI coach, Avo™, will create
daily actions just for you, and reach out with tips and insights when you need them, to keep you
moving forward. You’ll see fresh educational content in the app based on the food, hydration, and
physical activity you log. We’ll recommend an intermittent fasting schedule that suits your weight
loss goals and timeline. The reminders we send will match your schedule and tracking activity (for
instance, if you haven’t logged any water today, we’ll remind you to grab a drink).
Can I trust Simple’s science?
You 100% can trust Simple’s science, whether it’s in-app, on the blog, or on our social media. We
take science very seriously, so all of our content is written using accurate, credible, and reliable
research. It’s also reviewed thoroughly by our experts before being released and refreshed regularly
to keep it up to date.

What do we treat?
Cold, coughs, flu
If you have a high temperature or a new, continuous cough, or live with someone who does it could be
coronavirus (COVID-19). Stay at home for 14 days because it can take 14 days for symptoms to appear.
You can use the 111 service if you are unsure of what to do.
Skin conditions
Skin conditions are very common. From red, dry or itchy skin to lumps, bumps, to infections. If you
have any concerns about your skin and would like to speak to one of our GPs, download the app and
book an appointment today.
STIs, STDs and UTIs
Urinary tract infections (UTI’s) are very common especially in women and can be very uncomfortable.
Sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) — or sexually transmitted infections (STIs) — are generally
acquired by sexual contact. You should make an appointment with a doctor immediately if you have
signs of an STI, STD or UTI as they can become dangerous if left untreated.
Digestive problems
There are varying digestive problems that can often cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation
or abdominal pain. If you have persistent digestive problems which keep returning or severe
abdominal pain, you should speak to a doctor as soon as possible.
And much more
You can speak to our doctors and nurses for a whole range of conditions. The ones listed here are
just the most common.
What don’t we treat?
Fractures
A fracture is a broken bone and will be severely painful. It may be swollen or bruised and usually
you will be unable to move it. The most common way to evaluate a fracture is with x-rays, which
provide clear images of bone. If you think you may have broken your toe or finger, go to an urgent
care centre. Go to your nearest accident and emergency (A&E) department for a broken arm or leg.

You can use the 111 service if you are unsure of what to do.
Skin conditions
Skin conditions are very common. From red, dry or itchy skin to lumps, bumps, to infections. If you
have any concerns about your skin and would like to speak to one of our GPs, download the app and
book an appointment today.
STIs, STDs and UTIs
Urinary tract infections (UTI’s) are very common especially in women and can be very uncomfortable.
Sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) — or sexually transmitted infections (STIs) — are generally
acquired by sexual contact. You should make an appointment with a doctor immediately if you have
signs of an STI, STD or UTI as they can become dangerous if left untreated.
Digestive problems
There are varying digestive problems that can often cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation
or abdominal pain. If you have persistent digestive problems which keep returning or severe
abdominal pain, you should speak to a doctor as soon as possible.
And much more
You can speak to our doctors and nurses for a whole range of conditions. The ones listed here are
just the most common.
What don’t we treat?
Fractures
A fracture is a broken bone and will be severely painful. It may be swollen or bruised and usually
you will be unable to move it. The most common way to evaluate a fracture is with x-rays, which
provide clear images of bone. If you think you may have broken your toe or finger, go to an urgent
care centre. Go to your nearest accident and emergency (A&E) department for a broken arm or leg.
Bleeding
There are many different causes of bleeding, some may not be anything to worry about however others
may require you to visit A&E. Severe bleeding that cannot be stopped, has been caused by trauma,
impact or inury should be dealt wth at your nearest accident and emergency (A&E) department.
Breathing difficulties or allergic reactions
Anaphylaxis is a severe and potentially life-threatening reaction to a trigger such as an allergy.
If you or someone you are with is feeling lightheaded, has breathing difficulties, clammy skin,
confusion, collapsing or loses consciousness you should call 999 for an ambulance immediately (even
if they start to feel better).
Loss of consciousness
Disorders of consciousness can occur if the parts of the brain responsible for consciousness are
injured or damaged.
Chest pain
Get immediate medical help by calling 999 if you have sudden chest pain that started with shortness
of breath, sweating and feeling or being sick, pain that spreads to your arms, back, neck or jaw,
makes your chest feel tight or heavy or lasts more than 15 minutes. You can book a GP appointment if
you have chest pain that comes and goes.

### Your questions answered

Why choose Virtu Health?

Virtu Health prides itself on been the little guy, we are NOT big pharma, and our practice reflects
this, putting the patients’ needs before profits. With Virtu Health, we can guarantee consistency in
practitioners and a considered approach to care, we are counsellors after all. Our Google Reviews
reflect this!

Do I need a referral access to these services?

No referral is required! You can directly reach out to us to book an appointment. We believe in
making mental health support as accessible as possible, so we keep the process simple and
straightforward.

What age groups do you support?

Our services** support adults aged 18 years and over.** For individuals under 18, we are happy to
provide mental health assessments and medication reviews for standard treatments where clinically
appropriate. However, prescriptions outside commonly prescribed mental health medications are only
available for patients aged 18 and above.

What mental health conditions do you treat?

We offer services for a broad range of mental health conditions, including but not limited to:
* **Anxiety**
* **Depression**
* **Trauma and PTSD**
* **Bipolar disorder**
* **Schizophrenia and psychosis**
* **Grief and loss**
* **Stress management**
* **Mood disorders**
* **Self-esteem and relationship issues**

What treatments can I choose from, do you have a catalogue?

In short, no. We will prescribe treatments that are most suited to you and your presenting problem.
We are brand agnostic, meaning we can prescribe anything that is available in Australia.

We are not aligned with any brand or wholesaler, and do not profit from the medication we choose.

Can you choose your own pharmacy?

We prefer to send prescriptions to our partnered pharmacies as we have up-to-date information on
medications in stock.

It’s important to note if you choose your own pharmacy, they may need to order medication, which can
take 1-2 weeks to organise (most pharmacy will only stock one or two brands – this is why they have
to order medication from wholesalers which can take time).

However, with our partnered pharmacies, we can address any concerns instantly and ensure a smoother
process for you.

Am I eligible for Virtu Health Chronic Condition Clinic?

To determine your eligibility for Virtu Health Chronic Condition Clinic, we would need to assess
your specific health condition and medical history.

To qualify for Virtu Health Chronic Condition Clinic, you must meet the following criteria:

**Chronic Condition: **Your condition must be chronic, lasting three or more months.

**Previous Treatment:** You must have tried other treatments that either did not fully alleviate
your symptoms or caused undesirable side effects.

**Exclusions:** History of psychosis or schizophrenia. Cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, or
liver disease. History of drug dependence.

I already have TGA approval can I bypass the initial consultation?

No. TGA approval concerns the prescriber rather than the client. When a client visits a new clinic
or consults a different doctor or prescriber, it’s essential for the prescriber to secure

TGA approval before prescribing the medication.
* TGA approvals might take 1-3 business days.

What Is Complementary or Alternative Medicine — and Why Is It Discussed in Chronic Conditions?

Complementary medicine refers to therapies used **alongside conventional medical treatment**, while
alternative medicine describes therapies used **instead of standard medical care**. In Australia,
most reputable clinicians discuss complementary therapies as part of an *integrated* approach —
meaning they are considered in addition to, not in place of, appropriate medical management.

Examples of complementary approaches may include:
* Nutritional and lifestyle interventions
* Mind–body therapies such as meditation or psychological support
* Physical therapies
* Prescribed medicinal cannabis in carefully assessed cases

When managing chronic conditions — such as persistent pain, anxiety disorders, sleep disturbances or
other long-term health concerns — treatment is rarely “one size fits all.” These conditions often
require ongoing review, symptom monitoring and adjustments over time. That’s why conversations
sometimes extend beyond standard medications alone.

Chronic conditions are discussed in the context of complementary medicine because:
* Symptoms may fluctuate or persist despite first-line treatments
* Some patients experience side effects from conventional medications
* Quality of life and functional goals vary between individuals
* Long-term management often requires a broader, individualised plan

For example, in certain circumstances, a clinician may assess whether prescribed medicinal cannabis
is appropriate as part of a structured care plan. This involves reviewing diagnosis, prior
treatments, mental health history, medication interactions and safety considerations before any
decision is made.

## More than telehealth

Amwell provides payers and healthcare systems with a single technology-based care platform. Working
with our clients, we help people get easier access to care across the continuum. This includes many
healthcare programs from Amwell and our growing list of partners.  

## Redefining mental healthcare at scale

A landmark, NIMH-funded study across 26 U.S. colleges shows how proactive, population-based, digital
behavioral health can identify need earlier and measurably reduce mental disorders over time.
* Early screening + digital intervention **lowered disorder prevalence by up to 4.9%**, with
  sustained impact over 2 years. 
* Participation more than doubled—**74.4% vs. 30.2%**—proving accessible, guided tools get people
  into care.
* A **3.8% reduction** at scale translated to up to **$1.18M in avoided costs**, showing real
  clinical and financial value.

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]

Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.

# Extend Your Care Team with a Virtual Health System

Reduce staffing gaps, improve patient outcomes, and expand access to specialty care.

[View Our Services][25]

#### Virtual Care, Perfected.

Avel eCare was one of the first Virtual Health System in the nation to start offering
clinician-to-clinician services via a virtual health system platform. Since 1993, Avel’s
multi-disciplinary teams have delivered exceptional virtual care impacting millions of patients in
communities across the United States.

[Joint commission seal/badge]

The Joint Commission’s standards are based on expert input and scientific evidence to help
healthcare organizations measure, assess, and improve performance.

## Virtual Health System with Proven Excellence

### 3M+

Patients Treated Every Year



#### How it works

[][26]

### The National Healthcare Challenges Avel is Solving

Avel eCare is fundamentally changing the way healthcare is delivered in this country by solving
industry-wide problems.

##### 1) Solve Clinical Staffing Shortage

Managing clinical staffing is crucial, from recruitment, to retention, and limiting burnout. Avel’s
board-certified physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, social workers, and
more embed with your staff and allow for efficient staffing models and ensure excellent patient
care.

##### 2) Expand Access to Care

Working with Avel eCare allows for expanded access to a suite of physicians and clinicians
representing 15 distinct specialties. Hospitals and clinics can treat more patients locally by
partnering with Avel.

##### 3) Improve Patient Outcomes

Avel eCare is a TJC accredited virtual hospital. Our customers have access to physicians, nurses,
and clinicians that are virtual health system experts. Avel’s customers count on improved patient
outcomes due to the added support and expertise.

##### 4) Improve Financial Outcomes

Avel’s unique business model allows hospitals and health systems to employ more flexible staffing
models, limit transfer rates, and treat more patients locally. Avel has a proven track record of
reducing unnecessary costs and driving more revenue for our customers.

## Our Services

Avel delivers the broadest array of solutions and care delivery models to meet the needs of a wide
range of hospitals, care centers, health systems and other ambulatory care providers.

[Learn More][27]
[Mind Map Final drop shadow]

## Pharmacy

Facilities and hospitals count on Avel eCare Pharmacy to meet their pharmaceutical needs 24/7/365.
Avel pharmacists partner with local pharmacies and/or professional staff to ensure patients receive
the safest and most effective medication management..



## Hospitalist

Avel eCare Hospitalist virtual health system services deliver high-quality care and management of
complex, medical and surgical patients who are 18 years of age and older.



## Senior Care

Avel eCare Senior Care works with facilities to be a 24/7 extension of their local care team,
providing round-the-clock service to senior care residents to augment care and improve outcomes.



## School Health

Avel eCare School Health provides nurse coverage for the entire school day and ensures immediate
response to student needs. School systems can count on school nurse experts to manage student health
while reducing the burden on staff.



## Behavioral Health

Avel eCare Behavioral Health provides emergency departments, inpatient behavioral health, and acute
inpatient units with expert evaluations from mental health professionals.



## Critical Care/ICU

Avel eCare ICU provides critically ill patients with 24/7 monitoring and support. This innovative
model connects hospitals to board-certified intensivists for constant monitoring, faster
interventions, and lower risks from complications.



## EMS

Partner with Avel eCare EMS to expedite care and provide the best pre-hospital care possible to your
community. Ave is here to support EMS personnel by lending a virtual hand when they need it.



## Crisis Care

Avel eCare Crisis Care is a virtual co-responder solution that supports Law Enforcement with 24/7
access to behavioral health experts who can de-escalate situations and help treat individuals in
crisis.



## Specialty Clinic

Avel eCare Specialty Clinic provides access to medical specialty care through high-definition,
interactive video technology. More than 15 distinct specialties are available for on-demand or
scheduled consults.



# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# The Right
# Care, When it Matters

Lyric is a virtual-first healthcare platform built to streamline access, reduce friction, and drive
meaningful claims cost reduction by guiding members to the right care, when and how they need it. By
combining an integrated suite of virtual care services with 24/7 care navigation, Lyric delivers a
seamless, connected healthcare experience from first touch to resolution.

[ Request a Demo ][23]

A Virtual-First Care Platform Built for Modern Healthcare Access

Lyric delivers a comprehensive virtual-first care experience that replaces fragmented point
solutions with a single, connected platform. From primary and urgent care to behavioral health,
men’s and women’s health, musculoskeletal care, and chronic condition management, Lyric expands
access to high-quality care while supporting smarter utilization.

## A virtual-first approach to member navigation

Connecting a fragmented healthcare system

At Lyric, our integrated approach to virtual care treats the complete you. From triage and specialty
referral to treatment and beyond. Our simple-to-use virtual care suite integrates labs, pharmacy,
and RPM tools to support both acute and chronic care. It’s thoughtful, more inclusive care that
enhances value and improves healthcare outcomes.

## Integrated Care from an
## award-winning team

Our nationwide network of licensed physicians, pediatricians, dermatologists, psychiatrists, and
therapists delivers personalized care for a wide range of medical and mental health needs.

With an average of over 10 years of professional experience, our providers are highly skilled and
knowledgeable.

Our clinical team is dedicated to providing compassionate, friendly, and expert care, connecting
with patients through phone or video for a seamless and supportive healthcare experience.

[ Learn More ][24]

Urgent Care

24/7 on-demand access to licensed physicians to help with non-emergency needs

Primary Care

Get ongoing, personalized care from a provider committed to your complete health

Mental Health

Visit with a caring mental health professional for depression, anxiety, or other concerns

Get a treatment plan for acne, eczema, or other conditions

healthcare providers to monitor streamed vital data from remotely located patients as well video
conference using HIPAA compliant video.

#### Real-time Telehealth

GTS’s remote telemonitoring program allows us to manage a patient’s condition daily from any
location - within or outside the US. The program utilizes state-of-the-art technology, advanced
telemetric equipment and custom-designed assessments to provide effective, remote patient care.

GTS offers an assortment of telehealth tools that enable healthcare providers to design a global
monitoring platform that best fits their organization's needs. For ease of use, convenience and
efficiency, the monitoring platform and data collected can be accessed through a tablet, smartphone,
computer or application.

[GTS VirtualHealth - Telehealth Software]

#### Store and Forward Technology

Includes digital images, video, audio and clinical data that can be "stored" on the client's
computer and when appropriate, information can be transmitted securely through our HIPAA compliant
servers ("forwarded") to the healthcare provider for improved patient care and coordination.

GTS telehealth tools can be used for a variety of applications such as transmitting medical images
and data for diagnosis; education, prevention and promotion of healthy behavior, and notification of
emergent cases. Telehealth monitors the patient between physician office visits and is very
beneficial to patients whose healthcare options are limited due to distance.

**time,** **I** **didn't** **know** **that** **that** **was** **going** **to** **be** **me**
**someday.** **But** **I** **kind** **of** **thought** **maybe** **someday it might.** **And**

00:13-00:24

restaurant booth, with Mary leaning her head on Peggy’s shoulder; the fourth photo is of them at a

**Caption**: Peggy

**Peggy: We** **have** **been** **married** **since** **2014.** **We** **have** **been**
**together** **for 30 years.** **I** **chased** **her** **for** **six** **months.** **Then** **she**

[The scene then returns to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**I** **couldn't** **remember** **which** **road** **to** **take.** **Finding** **errors** **that**
**I** **normally** **wouldn't** **have** **made** **that** **were** **so** **simple** **and** **so**
**easy.**

[A photo of Mary at a doctor’s office, completing a cognitive assessment appears. The scene then

# Welcome to OnPatient

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

Palm Primary Care carries forward the same mission, core values, and guiding principles of genuine
kindness that have made [Palm Medical Centers][55] renowned for its community-focused primary care
centers in Florida.

We are dedicated to catering to the primary care needs of adult and senior patients residing in the
communities we serve. With our overall practice, we are presently servicing to a patient base
exceeding 50,000, achieving a remarkable satisfaction rate of over 98%.

## Got a question?

Can the Simple app help me lose weight?
The Simple app can help you lose weight — and it can help you with much more than that, too. You'll
learn how to make healthy, balanced eating choices. You'll feel more confident and in control with
food. You'll get fitter, drink more water, and have more energy. You'll develop the skills to
prioritize self-care and live a healthier lifestyle. (We're excited for you, honestly!)
Does Simple make me count calories, cut out carbs, or weigh all my food?
Nope. The Simple method doesn't include calorie counting, cutting out essential food groups, or
weighing every bite. Instead, we prioritize safety and sustainability. So, we'll coach you to lose
weight through a behavior change approach that teaches you how to meet your nutritional needs, get
active, safely intermittent fast, and more.
How will Simple’s coaching be customized to me?
The coaching experience you’ll get with Simple is built around you. From the moment you create your
Simple account, you’re the star of the show. Here’s how: Your personal AI coach, Avo™, will create
daily actions just for you, and reach out with tips and insights when you need them, to keep you
moving forward. You’ll see fresh educational content in the app based on the food, hydration, and
physical activity you log. We’ll recommend an intermittent fasting schedule that suits your weight
loss goals and timeline. The reminders we send will match your schedule and tracking activity (for
instance, if you haven’t logged any water today, we’ll remind you to grab a drink).

to keep it up to date.

What Is Complementary or Alternative Medicine — and Why Is It Discussed in Chronic Conditions?

Complementary medicine refers to therapies used **alongside conventional medical treatment**, while
alternative medicine describes therapies used **instead of standard medical care**. In Australia,
most reputable clinicians discuss complementary therapies as part of an *integrated* approach —
meaning they are considered in addition to, not in place of, appropriate medical management.

Examples of complementary approaches may include:
* Nutritional and lifestyle interventions
* Mind–body therapies such as meditation or psychological support
* Physical therapies
* Prescribed medicinal cannabis in carefully assessed cases

When managing chronic conditions — such as persistent pain, anxiety disorders, sleep disturbances or
other long-term health concerns — treatment is rarely “one size fits all.” These conditions often
require ongoing review, symptom monitoring and adjustments over time. That’s why conversations
sometimes extend beyond standard medications alone.

Chronic conditions are discussed in the context of complementary medicine because:
* Symptoms may fluctuate or persist despite first-line treatments
* Some patients experience side effects from conventional medications
* Quality of life and functional goals vary between individuals
* Long-term management often requires a broader, individualised plan

For example, in certain circumstances, a clinician may assess whether prescribed medicinal cannabis
is appropriate as part of a structured care plan. This involves reviewing diagnosis, prior
treatments, mental health history, medication interactions and safety considerations before any
decision is made.
